item.title: Self-Hosted Forest Inventory Platforms in 2026: Open Foris Collect vs Arena vs Collect Earth Online
item.description: National forest inventories still run on spreadsheets emailed between field crews, and that is exactly where the data dies. A single country-level inventory can involve thousands of plots, dozens of field teams, and five-year reporting cycles — and if your data pipeline is a shared drive, you are one laptop failure away from re-measuring a forest. The Open Foris stack is the most complete open-source answer to this problem that exists, and unlike most scientific software, all of it runs on infrastructure you control.
